items.name: sticker-roll-preloader
items.title: Sticker Roll Preloader
items.description: A playful odometer preloader: oversized digits roll from 0 to 100 while visitors stamp a trail of die-cut stickers with their cursor, then the screen opens with a staggered curtain reveal.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: Workflow connectors: light pulses travel between any elements along stepped, curved or straight beams, and the beams re-route themselves as your layout responds.

items.name: ascii-footer
items.title: ASCII Footer
items.description: A complete site footer, just like bydot.co's: logo, tagline, link columns and a live local clock, then a big fading wordmark over an interactive ASCII trail that follows the cursor.

items.name: curved-gallery
items.title: Curved Gallery
items.description: A ring of images curving towards you. It drifts on its own, drags and flicks with momentum, settles neatly on an image, and keeps the same composition from desktop down to phones.

items.name: text-reveal-preloader
items.title: Text Reveal Preloader
items.description: Words rise in letter by letter with a kinetic skew and swap one after another. The last word holds, lifts away, and the screen reveals your page.

items.name: image-scroll-preloader
items.title: Image Scroll Preloader
items.description: Two columns of images scroll upward on either half of the screen while a small counter rises from bottom to top. At 100 the halves part to reveal your page.

items.name: trend-card
items.title: Trend Card
items.description: A minimal bento card for a key figure: a small label, the latest value and its change, and a smooth chart with a dot and a weekday or month under each value. Point at it to read any value.

items.name: glass-key
items.title: Glass Key
items.description: A clear glass keycap in real 3D, with liquid light flowing inside it and a printed label on top. It turns gently towards your cursor, like a product shot you can play with.

items.name: people-globe
items.title: People Globe
items.description: A dotted globe where people pin themselves, like a friend map: search a city, add a name and photo, and their avatar appears. People in the same city share one pin. Drag to spin, tap a pin to fly to it.

items.name: liquid-metal
items.title: Liquid Metal Logo
items.description: Turns any logo into flowing liquid metal: polished mirror chrome with round, tube-like edges and twinkling star glints, whose reflections ripple like mercury and follow the pointer. An iridescent finish is one switch away.

items.name: pixel-assistant
items.title: Pixel Assistant
items.description: An AI chat with a pixel-art character that feels alive: it blinks, watches you type, thinks, talks while replies stream in, and naps when things go quiet. Close it to leave just the character. Bring your own AI.

items.name: iso-card-stack
items.title: Iso Card Stack
items.description: An isometric document pipeline on a round base: the front card works with its task icon, shows a check when it's done and lifts away, the others step forward and a new card drops in with its lines writing themselves in.

items.name: constellation-preloader
items.title: Constellation Preloader
items.description: A single dot bursts into a ring of twelve, a thread runs from dot to dot and weaves a star, spokes fill it into a sunburst that turns one step, then it all folds back into one dot, which opens up to reveal the page.

items.name: neural-brain
items.title: Neural Brain
items.description: A brain drawn as a dense web of neurons that blink softly and fire, with signals that can race from neuron to neuron in chain reactions. It sways to show its depth and fires wherever you hover or click.

items.name: particle-logo
items.title: Particle Logo
items.description: Your logo drawn in thousands of glittering particles. Some drift away in a slow, smooth stream up and down, fanning out and fading, then return to their place, so the logo seems to breathe out dust.
